name: archmages_vicalyke_multiply_chance_pct
notes: diablocraft-6cw6f (Archmage's Vicalyke, legendary 016; docs/research/legendary-catalogue.csv row 352): the chance, in percent, that a Mirror Image killed by an enemy multiplies (one more Image appears where it stood, with the dead one's remaining time) while the hat is worn. D3's item text says only 'a chance' and no source or Power file gives a number. The designer's number: 50 (card q-1013-16, 2026-10-13, diablocraft-e8q7g). Blank reads 0: the power does nothing. 0 never, 100 always; set at run time with `.dc tunables set wizard archmages_vicalyke_multiply_chance_pct <n>`

name: ray_of_frost_pierce_width_yards
notes: diablocraft-n8eqs (Light of Grace, legendary 024; docs/research/legendary-catalogue.csv row 362; decisions.md 2026-10-13): how wide, in yards, Ray of Frost's beam is while Light of Grace is worn, so it hits every enemy on its line. D3's item text is only 'Ray of Frost now pierces.' and no source gives Ray of Frost a beam width: 4 yd is BORROWED from Disintegrate's line_pierce (skill_targeting.csv:32, d3planner simulator wizard.js:355, twice the half-width 2). The PM's ruling, the designer may overrule it. Blank or 0 turns the pierce off.

name: energy_twister_speed_yards_per_second
notes: diablocraft-3ypq2 (Energy Twister's travel, ruling q-1013-17 (a)), diablocraft-1np46 (ruling q-1014-07): how fast a travelling twister (the base skill and every rune but Wicked Wind) wanders from the aim point. d3_value is d3planner's (data/d3/wizard_skill_values.csv travel_speed_yards_per_second: simulator/wizard.js:543, 0.25 yards a frame at 60 frames). value is the designer's final 5, neither the 3.3 the skill's 20-yard range over its 6-second dot_duration_seconds gave nor D3's 15. Blank value reads d3_value. 0 stands the twister still

name: energy_twister_hit_radius_yards
notes: diablocraft-3ypq2: how far from a travelling twister's centre an enemy is hit by each tick (one every interval_seconds, the first at once). d3_value is the skill's radius, data/d3/skill_targeting.csv:38 (d3planner simulator/wizard.js:538). 0 hits nothing

name: energy_twister_turn_limit_degrees
notes: diablocraft-3ypq2 (ruling q-1013-17 (a)): the most a travelling twister turns at each turn, either way; each turn is random within it and forward-biased (the limit times the difference of two rolls, src/classes/wizard/dc_twister_math.h). No source gives D3's wander; 45 is the card's default. 0 is a straight path

name: energy_twister_turn_interval_seconds
notes: diablocraft-3ypq2 (ruling q-1013-17 (a)): how often a travelling twister turns; the first second goes straight ahead from the Wizard toward the aim point. No source gives D3's; 1 is the card's default. 0 never turns

name: tal_rashas_elements_immunity_seconds
notes: diablocraft-fkcp2 (Tal Rasha's Elements 2-piece, legendary set): the seconds the player is immune to an element after damage with it drops a Meteor of that type. D3's set text says only 'immune to that element' (data.json, the d3planner set text) and no source or Power file gives a duration; the designer set it to 8 (decisions.md 2026-10-16, card q-1016-09; the 4-piece's resistances last 8 s too). Blank reads 0: the Meteor drops and there is no immunity. Set at run time with `.dc tunables set wizard tal_rashas_elements_immunity_seconds <n>`

name: electrocute_jump_radius_yards
notes: diablocraft-d00zm (Wizard Electrocute jumps as D3; decisions.md 2026-10-14): how far, in yards, Electrocute's bolt jumps from the enemy it is on to the next (the nearest one it has not hit; Wizard::Jumps). D3's: Power/Wizard_Electrocute.pow SF_2 'Target Search Radius' = 15 (decode_pow.py power Wizard_Electrocute; SF_15 'Initial Target Search Radius' 7 is the first target's), and the community server reads SF_2 as the bounce search radius (reference/blizzless-diiis Wizard.cs WizardElectrocute: GetEnemiesInRadius(curTarget.Position, ScriptFormula(2), ...)). The PM's default was 10 yd (the core's magic chain default) on the reading that no source gave D3's; SF_2 is that source, so the row carries D3's 15 (PM defaults follow D3). The designer can set value to overrule. Blank or 0: the bolt does not jump
